Good News for Pets on Brightwater

At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk keeps pet travel calm, clear, and kind from check-in to landing. Brightwater names Larkspur Shelf as the deck where pets travel, and Brightwater names Fara Noll as the person who handles pets on board. That setup helps staff and travelers know exactly where care lives during the trip, with a steady focus on comfort, safety, and quick answers when plans need attention.

We like to keep every journey feeling shared, not stressful, and that means listening closely, checking details, and stepping through any concern one part at a time. If you are traveling with a companion animal, you can count on a patient approach and a team that treats each pet like a valued guest. Customer Advocate, Companion Animal Travel Desk
